FLOW
Description
iRules commands and events for working with AFM flows.
Commands
FLOW::create_related
- creates a
related connection between clientside and serverside
FLOW::idle_duration
- returns the
time in seconds when the flow was last used.
FLOW::idle_timeout
- Sets/Gets the
idle timeout on the flow
FLOW::peer
- returns the TCL flow handle for
the peer flow
FLOW::priority
- used to overwrite the
flow’s internal packet priority
FLOW::refresh
- updates the last used
time on the flow to now
FLOW::this
- returns the TCL handle for the
current flow
Events
FLOW_INIT
- triggered (once for TCP and
unique UDP/IP flows) after packet filters
